java_locations.role: Calls TextBlockUtils.getMinMax(this, stringBounder, false) and translates the complete painted graph by 6 minus its actual minimum.
Constructs MinMaxMutable.getEmpty(initToZero); the false argument leaves both axes empty rather than inserting the origin.
Makes the difference between an empty painted frontier and a zero-seeded frontier explicit.

rust_locations.role: Folds all painted candidates from 0.0 whenever diagram.together is empty, causing an invisible origin to beat positive painted minima.
Already folds from positive infinity and returns zero only when there are no finite painted candidates, matching Java's empty-MinMax lifecycle.

claimed_invariant: Every non-degenerate Class SVEK result normalizes from the minimum of primitives actually painted by SvekResult. LimitFinder is initialized empty on both axes. Coordinate zero has no special status: a positive painted minimum moves left/up to six, while a negative minimum moves right/down to six. Only a genuinely empty candidate set yields no translation.
causal_divergence: Rust's horizontal helper seeds the fold with 0.0 for ordinary root diagrams. A fresh note-only graph whose leftmost visible primitive begins five pixels inside a solved xlabel therefore reports minX=0 instead of the painted minX=5, retaining unpainted space and placing the note outline at x=11 instead of Java's x=6. Clustered diagrams happened to use an infinity seed and did not expose this branch.
planned_model_change: Fold horizontal painted candidates from positive infinity for every Class SVEK topology, mirroring svek_layout_y_bias and Java LimitFinder(false). Return zero only when no finite candidate exists. Keep the relationship-aware painted-frontier mapping and package normalization unchanged. Add model tests with all-positive, negative, and empty candidates; do not add coordinate offsets.
perturbation_axes: renamed labels whose widths move the painted frontier
scope_boundary: This mechanism owns only initialization and empty-set semantics of Class horizontal painted-MinMax normalization. It does not own note preferred dimensions, note text padding, Graphviz label placement, routes, collision order, vertical normalization, comparator slack, baselines, park lists, error markers, or guard allow-lists.
acceptance: The preserved note-only root perturbation normalizes its painted note path to x=6 once its independent text-padding geometry is also modeled.
Synthetic tests prove positive minima are not clamped to zero and negative minima retain their translation direction.
Existing nested-package horizontal-frontier perturbations remain unchanged or improve.
Full renderer and no-oracle suites show no new failures.
A separate checker creates fresh root/together and positive/negative frontier inputs and records a verdict.
forbidden_approaches: subtracting five pixels for root or note diagrams
keying normalization to ORTHO, note position, fixture names, labels, or topology counts
changing Graphviz coordinates or SVG strings after rendering
changing comparator slack, baselines, park lists, error markers, or guard allow-lists
